name: slides-for-product-managers-pack
description: 32 Claude Skills for every deck a product person makes, drafted in Claude Slides from your own sources, in six groups: start every deck (a deck context file with a metric dictionary giving each metric an owner, source, base and period; a slide design system written as rules; a one-page deck brief naming the decider and the ask; a ghost deck of action titles; a doc turned into slides; one master deck cut per audience); decks for leaders (the one-slide and two-slide executive summaries, the roadmap review with confidence labels and a costed no list, the strategy deck with diagnosis and guiding policy, the QBR with commitments versus actuals and written RAG definitions, the business case with do-nothing and kill criteria, the board pre-read); updates for everyone (the stakeholder update, the all-hands, the research readout, the product onboarding deck); team decks (sprint review, retrospective, working agreement, OKR check-in, kickoff, offsite); decks for customers and the market (launch and sales enablement, case study slides with a permission check, the demo deck, the advisory board session, the conference talk); and the passes that make a deck hold up (a numbers register tracing every figure, the build in your design system, the one-claim-per-slide restyle, the read-cold pre-read slidedoc). For product managers, product owners, heads of product and anyone who makes decks about the product. Claude Slides drafts the deck from your sources; every number on a slide traces to one, nothing is invented to fill a gap, and you decide what the room is asked to decide.
